QC-POST-100-008/AC-01: PostgreSQL major=18, exact SHA/dirty source fingerprint, schema digest, migration head/checksums and fixture identity are present for every accepted result; 0 checksum mismatches or affected orphans.
QC-POST-100-008/AC-02: Every assigned persistent ledger criterion passes real FK/unique/check/index, optimistic-version, transaction, audit/outbox rollback, duplicate and concurrent-write cases; 0 unauthorized mutations.
QC-POST-100-008/AC-03: Applicable migration/integration/concurrency/security tests execute with 0 FAIL and 0 unexplained SKIP; unavailable runtime remains BLOCKED, never mock PASS.
QC-POST-100-008/AC-ROW: For EVERY assigned row ID, provide a separate COMPONENT result: cite the full gap criterion, this prompt’s explicit acceptance component, expected/actual outcome, positive/negative cases and immutable evidence. 0 missing/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT VERIFIED owned component results; signed N/A only. A row/finding is CLOSED only after ALL owning prompts’ components and independentFINAL acceptance pass; one component never closes the whole gap.

Hard fail conditions
FAIL if any assigned criterion/evidence is missing; wrong SHA/fingerprint/schema/artifact/Node; invented policy/science/threshold/budget; mock/SQLite substitutes for PG18; action lacks server auth/audit; required test skipped; historical CI or provider state assumed; text field treated as e-signature; automated UAT/AT substituted; unsupported N/A or unresolved finding remains. Missing owner/source/provider/human/runtime input is BLOCKED/NOT VERIFIED and prevents closure.

Evidence artifacts required
audit/<final-candidate>/closure/QC-POST-100-008/candidate.json, scope-db-auth-manifest.json, criteria.json, commands-and-results.json, relevant PG18/E2E/runtime traces, manual-or-provider-signoffs where applicable, handoff.md; manifest includes SHA256 for every retained artifact. Historical evidence paths remain labeled HISTORICAL; paths here are required outputs, not present evidence.

Expected resulting finding statuses
Mapped original/new findings remain PARTIAL/OPEN/BLOCKED until every assigned closure criterion and downstream necessary evidence is accepted; then CLOSED with immutable same-candidate evidence reference. No source-only upgrade to CLOSED.

Expected resulting score/gate impact
Recompute only approved affected criterion numerators/denominators after independent evidence review; mapping adds0 points. Mandatory gate PASS only when all required trusted evidence is accepted; product readiness follows approved Go/NoGo policy.

Rollback / recovery considerations
Preserve dirty work, old migrations, immutable evidence and history. Isolate fixtures/provider recovery targets; take approved pre-change backup when required. Use reviewed forward-fix or authorized rollback consistent with recorded schema/data. Unknown result: inspect records/history before retry. No restore performed merely by recording an intent.

Do NOT do
Do not commit/push/merge/deploy/run production migrations/change provider settings/send sensitive data without explicit authorization. Do not implement closed source repairs again, invent thresholds/roles/KPIs, weaken tests/privacy/auth guards, delete controlled history, treat mapping completion as100% readiness, or hide unresolved evidence.

prompts.gap: No exact-current-candidate complete CI run is accepted; historical results or dirty local build cannot substitute.
prompts.work: Freeze intended final candidate and source fingerprint. Use approved Node>=24.20.0<25 and current pnpm contract, verification:begin immediately before final build. Execute current equivalents of format:check, lint, typecheck, test:architecture, test:unit, test:integration, test:migrations, test:concurrency, test:security, build, authenticated E2E and evidence completeness. Bind run URL/id/SHA/runner/commands/counts/artifact/schema/fixture/expiry and preserved raw output. A dirty candidate needs an authorized stable commit/CI candidate before exact-SHA acceptance; this prompt does not authorize commit/push.
acceptance: CI run SHA == candidate SHA and its full source tree/fingerprint == the intended candidate; qualified Node/runner, 0 required FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT VERIFIED/unapproved SKIP.
All named current-script gates execute and retained results contain candidate/schema/build identity, source checksums, authenticated fixture evidence and exact counts; historical CI reused=0.
Verified build bytes and SHA256 are exported once with trusted evidence manifest; evidence completeness validates every required row and separates local proof from remote CI acceptance.
